subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a target-repository fix?
rationale: The bug and fix boundary are clear, but the only open implementation candidate is conflicting and not maintainer-modifiable, so automation should not queue a competing repair without a maintainer routing choice.

options.title: Replace the fork PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask for a rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it and enable maintainer edits if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open while accepting that the source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the affected TUI leading-strip path and are a strong routing candidate for the UI/TUI shared-stripper boundary decision.
